title: Made In Korea Trailer Out: Priyanka Mohan Stars In Netflix's India-Korea Coming-Of-Age Story | Web-series News - News18
text: Streaming giant Netflix has unveiled the official trailer of the upcoming film Made In Korea, offering audiences a first glimpse into a heartfelt cross-cultural journey of courage, identity and self-discovery. The film, directed by Ra. Karthik and starring Priyanka Mohan, is set to premiere globally on March 12. A Journey From Tamil Nadu To Seoul Made In Korea follows Shenba, a young woman from a small town in Tamil Nadu whose life takes an unexpected turn when she finds herself navigating the bustling streets of Seoul, South Korea. The story traces her emotional journey as she adjusts to an unfamiliar culture, meets new people and confronts moments of vulnerability while discovering her own strength. Set between the everyday rhythms of Tamil Nadu and the vibrant energy of Seoul, the film explores how unexpected encounters and quiet acts of courage shape Shenba’s path in a world far from home. A Cross-Cultural Collaboration Produced by Rise East Entertainment, the film brings together talent from India and South Korea. Alongside Priyanka Mohan, the film also features South Korean actors Park Hye-Jin and No Ho Jin, creating a cultural bridge that reflects the film’s theme of connection beyond borders. Written and directed by Ra. Karthik, Made In Korea aims to blend emotional storytelling with an authentic portrayal of two distinct cultures. Priyanka Mohan On Playing Shenba Speaking about the film, Priyanka Mohan described the role as deeply personal and transformative. “Made In Korea and Shenba’s journey is deeply personal to me. It’s about discovering strength in moments of uncertainty and learning to stand on your own. Portraying her evolution from vulnerability to independence was both challenging and deeply rewarding," she said. The actor added that working with Netflix for the first time made the project even more meaningful. “This being my first collaboration with Netflix makes it even more special, and I’m grateful that Shenba’s story will travel beyond borders and connect with audiences around the world." A Story Of Identity, Friendship And Growth With themes of identity, friendship and resilience at its core, Made In Korea promises an uplifting coming-of-age narrative about finding one’s place in the world. By weaving together cultures from India and South Korea, the film aims to deliver an intimate story that resonates with global audiences. Made In Korea premieres exclusively on Netflix on March 12.
